This could be accomplished in a number of ways, most notably with firewall rules/whitelisting.

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the AccessMgrServlet endpoint. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
